extDescription.message: Checks for new mail in the Gmail accounts you're signed in to in Chrome. You choose which folders notify you and which only count.

stripLabel.message: Unread count for each mailbox. Click one to open it.

bulkTooMany_one.message: There is $1 unread message, more than can be handled at once

bulkTooMany_other.message: There are $1 unread messages, more than can be handled at once

bulkTooManyNote.message: Only the newest 20 messages in each folder can be handled at once, and there are more in $1. Open these unread messages in Gmail to select and handle them yourself?

bulkConfirm_other.message: Mark all $1 unread messages as read?

bulkKeepsRunning.message: This keeps going even if you close this window.

bulkFailed.message: Mark all as read didn't finish

bulkLeft_one.message: $1 unread message remains, possibly one that just arrived. You can try again.

bulkLeft_other.message: $1 unread messages remain, possibly ones that just arrived. You can try again.

signedOutTitle.message: Chrome isn't signed in to Gmail.

signedOutPopup.message: Once you sign in, your unread mail is listed here.

noFoldersTitle.message: You haven't chosen any folders to track.

noFoldersText.message: Once you do, new mail shows up here.

markAllReadNamed_one.message: Mark $1 unread message in “$2” as read

markAllReadNamed_other.message: Mark all $1 unread messages in “$2” as read

boxNotTracked.message: This mailbox isn't tracking any folders. You can turn some on in Settings.

boxNoUnread.message: No unread mail in tracked folders.

moreInGmail_one.message: View $1 more unread message in Gmail

moreInGmail_other.message: View $1 more unread messages in Gmail

tooltipSignedOut.message: Pigeon Post for Gmail: not signed in to Gmail

bulkInterrupted.message: Stopped partway through. You can try again.

bulkBusy.message: This mailbox is already being marked as read

bulkNoFolders.message: This mailbox isn't tracking any folders

testMessage.message: This is a test notification. If you can see it, notifications are working.

notifReauth.message: Gmail needs you to verify again. Click this notification to open Gmail, verify, and try again.

messageGone.message: This message is no longer in the list

folderHint_important.message: Unread mail Gmail marks as important

folderHint_unread.message: Includes archived mail and mail under any label

errNetwork.message: Can't reach Gmail. Check your network connection.

errSignedOut.message: This account isn't signed in to Gmail

errNoToken.message: Couldn't find Gmail's action token. Open this Gmail mailbox in the browser once first.

errNoKey.message: Couldn't read Gmail's account key. Open this Gmail mailbox in the browser once first.

errNoThread.message: This message has no ID, so it can't be changed

errReauth.message: Gmail needs you to verify again. Try again after verifying.

foldersHeading.message: Which mail to notify you about

levelDesc_count.message: Added to the unread count on the toolbar icon

foldersNote.message: The number at the right of each row is its current unread count. Compare it with Gmail's left menu to make sure you picked the right folder.

badgeLegend.message: How the icon number is shown

badgeHelp.message: Separate numbers follow mailbox order. The icon only fits two-digit numbers for two or three mailboxes; when they don't fit, it shows the total. Hover over the icon to see each mailbox's unread count.

notifyHelp.message: When off, the toolbar icon still shows the unread count.

volumeHelp.message: Notifications play the mailbox's own sound, which you set next to each mailbox's name above. Set the volume to 0 for no sound.

groupLabel.message: When several new messages arrive at once

openLegend.message: When you click a notification or message

openReuse.message: Switch to an open Gmail tab

pollHelp.message: Gmail doesn't notify extensions on its own, so mail is checked on a schedule. Shorter intervals mean faster notifications.

loadingAccounts.message: Reading the Gmail accounts you're signed in to…

signedOutOptions.message: Sign in, then come back to this page to choose which folders notify you.

awayAccounts.message: This computer isn't signed in to $1. Their settings are kept and apply automatically once you sign in.

connected.message: Connected to $1. Changes save automatically and sync to other computers signed in to the same Chrome account.

primaryHint.message: Set only this one to skip notifications for promotions and social mail

soundNotAudio.message: Choose an audio file, such as mp3, wav, or ogg.

soundTooBig.message: This file is over 1 MB. Choose a shorter sound.

soundMissing.message: This computer doesn't have this mailbox's custom sound, so “$1” plays instead. Upload it again to fix this.

conflictText.message: $1 is set to $2, which already covers mail in every tab, so the settings for $3 have no effect.

conflictHelp.message: When a message is in several folders, the highest setting applies. To track only some tabs, lower the inbox setting.

labelsEmpty.message: No labels read for this mailbox yet. The button below reads label names from Gmail's left menu.

addLabelPlaceholder.message: Enter a label name from Gmail. Write nested labels as “Parent/Child”

labelsSource.message: Taken from Gmail's left menu, updated $1. Nested labels and labels under “More” only appear after you expand them once in Gmail.

addLabelManually.message: Can't find a label? Enter its name

labelsTimeout.message: Gmail didn't finish loading in time. Try again in a moment.

labelsWrongAccount.message: These are labels for $1, not this mailbox. Check which account Gmail is signed in to.

labelsNone.message: No labels found in Gmail's left menu. If your labels are under “More”, expand it in Gmail and read again.

pvBadgeSignedOut.message: When you're not signed in to Gmail, the icon shows “?”.

pvBadgeStale.message: Recounting unread mail with the new settings…

pvBadgeEmpty.message: No unread mail right now, so the icon shows no number.

pvBadgeSplit.message: The $1 on the icon is unread mail for $2, in that order.

pvBadgeLong.message: The numbers for each mailbox are too long to fit, so the icon shows the total, $1.

pvBadgeSingle.message: Only one mailbox tracks folders, so the icon shows its unread count, $1.

pvBadgeTotal.message: The $1 on the icon is the total unread mail in folders set to $2 and $3.

pvSubject.message: The subject appears on this line

pvEnvSignedOut.message: After you sign in to Gmail, a sample notification appears here.

pvEnvOff.message: Desktop notifications are off. Only the icon number updates.

pvEnvNone.message: No folders are set to $1, so no notifications appear.

pvEnvText.message: When new mail arrives in $1, you'll see a notification like this. The last line shows which mailbox it's for.

pvAccountsMulti.message: When you click the icon, each mailbox is listed separately like this and can be collapsed.

pvAccountsSingle.message: When you click the icon, the mailbox is labeled like this.

pvNotTracked.message: This mailbox isn't tracking any folders.

pvGroupEach.message: Each new message gets its own notification.

pvGroupAll.message: When several new messages arrive together, they're combined into one notification.

pvGroupOver_one.message: When more than $1 new message arrives at once, they're combined into one notification.

pvGroupOver_other.message: When more than $1 new messages arrive at once, they're combined into one notification.

testWhereWin.message: Google Chrome under Settings › System › Notifications

testDenied.message: Notifications for this extension are blocked. Allow them at chrome://settings/content/notifications and try again.

testSent.message: Sent. If you don't see it, allow notifications in $1 and make sure Do Not Disturb or Focus is off.

supportText.message: If you find it useful, you can buy me a boba or send a tip with PayPal.

supportCard.message: Boba is paid by card. No PayPal account needed.
